description: Read one list: every pick of a live list, or of one of the person's own. Accepts handle/slug, a bare slug, a title, or an id.

format.description: How to render the reply text. 'text' (default): numbered rows, one field per line, best for reading the list yourself. 'markdown': linked bold titles and quoted notes, for relaying the list to the user as-is.

list.description: Which list: handle/slug, slug, title, or id.

name: get_list
